name: Create your Zero Trust organization
description: Create your Zero Trust organization Sets up a Zero Trust organization for your account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations
Sets up a Zero Trust organization for your account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Get your Zero Trust organization
description: Get your Zero Trust organization Returns the configuration for your Zero Trust organization. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations
Returns the configuration for your Zero Trust organization.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Get your Zero Trust organization DoH settings
description: Get your Zero Trust organization DoH settings Returns the DoH settings for your Zero Trust organization. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations/doh
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations/doh
Returns the DoH settings for your Zero Trust organization.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Revoke all Access tokens for a user
description: Revoke all Access tokens for a user Revokes a user's access across all applications. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations/revoke_user
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/organizations/revoke_user
Revokes a user's access across all applications.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)
Optional: devices (query) — When set to `true`, all devices associated with the user will be revoked.
